purpose: Teach: 練馬/ニンテンドー/ローリング/ヤフオク/ホモ/シャロン/スタミナ/チャンピオンズ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、練馬区にお住まいだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer who lives in Nerima — Aoi was telling me about them.
lines.style: Warm, meandering thought. Soft entry. Pace relaxed, almost musing. Amusement underneath, gentle and private. Voice settles on the name like she's remembering.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ニンテンドーDS世代でいらっしゃるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Oh, Nintendo DS generation — Aoi mentioned that too.
lines.style: Thoughtful agreement. Light, recognizing smile in the voice. Slow pace. She's building a picture of this person with Aoi, turning details over. Genuine curiosity underneath.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ローリング・ストーンズのファンだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: And they're a Rolling Stones fan, apparently.
lines.style: Connecting the dots aloud. Quiet delight. Slight lift on 'apparently' — she likes when people have unexpected tastes. Gentle trailing into the next thought.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ヤフオクで限定品を集めてらっしゃるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi says they collect rare things on Yahoo Auctions.
lines.style: Small laugh underneath the words. Admiring, slightly conspiratorial. Slower pace — she's savoring the detail. Voice warm with the kind of affection you feel for someone's harmless obsessions.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ホモ・サピエンス研究をされてる学者だって、メイちゃん
lines.en: They're a scholar studying human evolution, I think.
lines.style: Respect in the delivery. Slight lift on 'scholar' — genuine admiration. Pace steadies. She's saying this like it matters, like it fits. Uncertain 'I think' — soft, checking in.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、シャロン元首相の伝記を読んでらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi saw them reading a biography of Sharon — you know, the former prime minister.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact observation. Warm curiosity. Pace unhurried. She's explaining gently, not assuming Aoi knows who Sharon is. Slight parenthetical about the 'former prime minister' — helpful, not condescending.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、登山スタミナがすごいって自慢されてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: And they wouldn't shut up about their mountain climbing stamina.
lines.style: Affectionate exasperation. Dry humor — not unkind. Slight laugh. She's teasing them gently, warmly. Pace quickens just slightly on 'wouldn't shut up.' Voice carries fondness underneath the wryness.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、チャンピオンズリーグ観戦が趣味だって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Soccer fan too — Champions League matches are their thing.
lines.style: Closing observation. Warm finality. Pace gentle, trailing off softly. Like she's set down the last piece of a puzzle and is satisfied with the picture. Fond, almost tender finish.
